label: Fires at GO after a rare a2->S1 rewarded trial, early episode most strongly.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_dec
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1)
explanation: Sparse feature (1.3% of steps), active only at GO, early-to-mid episode (the timing baseline falls toward zero by decile 6). Beyond timing, its magnitude is set by the previous trial: it is large after a rare a2->S1 rewarded trial, with that boost shrinking later in the episode (negative ep_dec interaction). After a common a1->S1 rewarded trial it gets only a small boost, and after every other pattern it stays near zero. Belief, the trial before, and belief_cover add nothing measurable on dev. Most of the remaining variance is episode-specific runs of strong firing (0.2-0.4) on consecutive rewarded S1 trials that the observed cues do not predict; the full ceiling (0.29) relies on the policy decile (model output). The free fit adds about 0.06 test R^2 over the short form (0.31 vs 0.25), mostly from the S1-reward x episode-decile term.
